reason: I already fill the boot once a week at Spinneys or Tawfeer and I see the prices myself. I would not hand my list to strangers and hope they really paid what they say, and the pickup window and the $2 on top do not make up for that.
objection: How do I know they really paid the cheap price at the till and did not add a markup? I only have their word, and a bag I have not checked is easy to pad.
would_change_my_mind: A photo of the till receipt with every bag, with the item prices I can check, and a neighbour I know who has used it for a month and says the totals are honest.
